ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

3. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.

4. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

6. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Only one word repeated

7. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. blue

8. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
